    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == 2 for row in grid))

    points = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (2, background)]
    if not points:
        return out
    min_c = min(c for r, c, v in points)
    max_c = max(c for r, c, v in points)
    if max_c < divider:
        shift = divider - 1 - max_c
        line_c = min_c + shift - 1
    else:
        shift = divider + 1 - min_c
        line_c = max_c + shift + 1
    for r, c, v in points:
        out[r][c] = background
    for r, c, v in points:
        out[r][c + shift] = v
    if 0 <= line_c < w:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][line_c] = 8
    return out
'''
